function.description:
**Pick this tool for ONE specific backup or restore execution when you already know the execution ID.**

This tool retrieves the full details for one backup or restore execution by execution UUID, including error diagnostics, task-level details, status, timing, and failure information.

**Use this tool when the user asks:**
- why a specific backup execution failed
- why a specific restore execution failed
- for detailed status of one execution
- for task-by-task details of one execution
- for error codes or error messages for one known execution

**Pick this tool for questions like:**
- "Why did backup execution <id> fail?"
- "Show details for restore job <id>"
- "What tasks ran in execution <id>?"
- "Give me the error for backup execution <id>"
- "Show execution diagnostics for <id>"

**Do NOT use this tool for:**
- listing all backup jobs or restore jobs
- discovering execution IDs
- listing available backups

Obtain the execution identifier from `api_getBackupRestoreExecutions`.
function.name: api_getBackupRestoreExecution
